fonts.display: 'sans-serif', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif
fonts.body: 'PP Neue Montreal', ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, sans-serif

palette.name: Sky Signal
palette.role: Blue action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments

palette.name: Electric Iris
palette.role: Outlined/ghost action border, inline link accent, focus rings — cooler and slightly deeper than Sky Signal

palette.name: Paper White
palette.role: Page canvas, primary surface, inverted text on dark bars

palette.name: Mist
palette.role: Subtle band backgrounds, section alternation, elevated surface tint

palette.name: Fog
palette.role: Card surface, soft fill behind product screenshots

palette.name: Linen
palette.role: Hairline dividers, faint borders, disabled surfaces

palette.name: Ash
palette.role: Ghost button background, subtle hover fill

palette.name: Inkstone
palette.role: Primary text, strongest contrast — carries the 200-weight headlines

palette.name: Slate
palette.role: Body text, secondary headings, dense body copy

palette.name: Pewter
palette.role: Muted body text, helper text, inactive nav

palette.name: Graphite
palette.role: Tertiary text, footer links, faint labels

palette.name: Silver
palette.role: Placeholder text, very faint borders, decorative strokes

palette.name: Obsidian
palette.role: Top announcement bar background, dark surface, inverted text fill

palette.name: Midnight
palette.role: Dark card surface, secondary dark fill
